# SOP-P1-L4-05 Planned shutdown - Heat Treat line

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-CN01, EQ-P1-L4-HP02, EQ-P1-L4-HT03

1. Preconditions  
   - Verify maintenance work order and scope match ECN-2026-007.  
   - Confirm spare parts and procedures available per MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 and MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3.  
   - Ensure production hold issued for P1-L4.

2. PPE  
   - Wear heat-resistant gloves, face shield, safety boots, and hearing protection.  
   - Use lockout/tagout kit and gas detector when opening furnace doors.  
   - Restrict access to authorized personnel only.

3. Isolate power and utilities  
   - Perform lockout/tagout on electrical supply and control panels for EQ-P1-L4-CN01, EQ-P1-L4-HP02, EQ-P1-L4-HT03.  
   - Drain and isolate hydraulic service lines to EQ-P1-L4-HP02. The system pressure limit for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is 300 bar. Confirm isolation prior to maintenance.

4. Cooldown and purge  
   - Allow furnace and conveyor systems to reach safe handling condition per MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3. Monitor atmosphere purge before door opening.  
   - The quench delay maximum for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is 15 seconds. Maintain quench sequencing as specified while transitioning to safe mode.

5. Mechanical disassembly and inspection  
   - Remove guards and shields following MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2. Inspect hydraulic fittings, seals, and quench delivery lines. Replace components per parts list in ECN-2026-007.

6. Test and verification prior to restart  
   - Reassemble guards, reapply utilities, and perform functional checks in accordance with MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 and MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3. Verify quench timing and hydraulic pressure alarms.

7. Cleanup and documentation  
   - Clean work area, return tools, and remove lockout/tagout devices only when safe.

8. Sign-off  
   - Maintenance Lead: __________________  
   - Shift Supervisor: __________________  
   - QA Inspector: __________________  
   - Reference records: ECN-2026-007, MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2, MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3
